name: DynamiCare Health
one_liner: A smartphone recovery program for alcohol, drug and nicotine use: remote breath and saliva tests, cash rewards for negative tests, and a recovery coach.
best_for: Adults working on alcohol, opioid, stimulant or nicotine use who respond to concrete rewards
People in outpatient addiction treatment who want extra accountability between visits
Families who want to support a loved one's recovery with verified testing
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who need medically supervised detox or withdrawal management
People without a smartphone or who are uncomfortable recording test videos
short_description: Smartphone contingency management for substance use: video-verified breath and saliva tests, rewards on a restricted debit card, and weekly coaching.
long_description: DynamiCare Health delivers contingency management, a behavioral treatment that rewards verified abstinence, through a smartphone app. Members get a breathalyzer (for alcohol or, in the smoking program, nicotine) and saliva drug-test strips, and submit tests on request by recording a selfie video that DynamiCare staff check. Negative tests and attending treatment earn money on a smart debit card that blocks spending at bars, casinos and on cash withdrawals, with rewards rising as sobriety lengthens. Each member has a recovery coach, typically for weekly one-hour video sessions, with text support in between. The full program runs about 12 months. It is offered directly to individuals and families and through health plans and treatment providers, and is meant as an add-on to treatment rather than a replacement for medical care or detox.

pricing.starting_price: From $20/week self-pay; some insurance plans cover it
pricing.notes: FAQ says self-pay programs start at $20/week, billed monthly with any add-ons. Plan pages also describe a $0/week option where the family deposits the reward money ($25/week suggested); check current plans at enrollment. Ask DynamiCare to check insurance coverage.

privacy.notes: Policy (read 2026-10-27) says it uses Google Ads remarketing and lets advertising partners set cookies to deliver targeted ads; account deletion on request (medical records retained under HIPAA).

clinical_trials.study: Pilot randomized trial of DynamiCare plus usual care vs usual care alone in outpatients with alcohol use disorder (90 days); feasibility focus, small sample

citation.title: Digital delivery of a contingency management intervention for substance use disorder: A feasibility study with DynamiCare Health

clinical_trials.outcome: Two-thirds used the app for at least 57 days; more app users remained in treatment at 90 days (24% vs 3%).

primary_uses: Support during opioid or stimulant use treatment

patient_summary: You use the DynamiCare app to take breath or saliva tests on video when prompted and earn money on a debit card for negative tests, while meeting weekly with a recovery coach. You start with a short survey and a call with the enrollment team. Self-pay programs start at $20 per week, and some insurance plans cover it.

availability.note: Enrolling individuals and families by phone and app; also offered through health plans and treatment programs. State-by-state availability not published.
